theorems.name: ProbabilityTheory.chebyshev_majority_bound
theorems.type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
  {k : Nat} {δ : Real},
  Real.instLT.lt 0 δ →
    Real.instLE.le (instHDiv.hDiv 9 δ) k.cast →
      ∀ (events : Fin k → Set Ω),
        (∀ (j : Fin k), MeasurableSet (events j)) →
          ProbabilityTheory.iIndepSet (fun j => events j) μ →
            (∀ (j : Fin k), GE.ge (MeasureTheory.Measure.instFunLike.coe μ (events j)) (ENNReal.ofReal (2 / 3))) →
              GE.ge
                (MeasureTheory.Measure.instFunLike.coe μ
                  (setOf fun ω =>
                    instLTNat.lt k
                      (instHMul.hMul 2
                        (Finset.filter (fun j => Set.instMembership.mem (events j) ω) Finset.univ).card)))
                (ENNReal.ofReal (instHSub.hSub 1 δ))

theorems.name: BinaryMatrix.assouad_transpose_vcDim
theorems.type:
∀ {m n : Nat} (M : BinaryMatrix m n) {d : Nat},
  instLENat.le M.vcDim d → instLENat.le M.transpose.vcDim (instHSub.hSub (instHPow.hPow 2 (instHAdd.hAdd d 1)) 1)

theorems.name: ProbabilityTheory.covering_minimax
theorems.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} {C : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype R] [inst_1 : Fintype C] [Nonempty C] [DecidableEq R] [DecidableEq C]
  (M : R → C → Bool) (v : Real),
  Real.instLT.lt 0 v →
    (∀ (q : ProbabilityTheory.FintypePMF C),
        Exists fun r =>
          Real.instLE.le v (Finset.univ.sum fun c => instHMul.hMul (q.prob c) (ite (Eq (M r c) Bool.true) 1 0))) →
      Exists fun p =>
        ∀ (c : C), Real.instLE.le (instHDiv.hDiv 1 (Fintype.card C).cast) (ProbabilityTheory.boolGamePayoff M p c)

theorems.name: ProbabilityTheory.finite_approx_minimax
theorems.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} {C : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype R] [inst_1 : Fintype C] [Nonempty C] [Nonempty R] [DecidableEq R]
  [DecidableEq C] (M : R → C → Bool) (v ε : Real),
  Real.instLT.lt 0 ε →
    (∀ (q : ProbabilityTheory.FintypePMF C),
        Exists fun r =>
          Real.instLE.le v (Finset.univ.sum fun c => instHMul.hMul (q.prob c) (ite (Eq (M r c) Bool.true) 1 0))) →
      Real.instLE.le (instHSub.hSub v ε) (instHDiv.hDiv 1 (Fintype.card C).cast) →
        Exists fun p => ∀ (c : C), Real.instLE.le (instHSub.hSub v ε) (ProbabilityTheory.boolGamePayoff M p c)

theorems.name: ProbabilityTheory.mwu_potential_T_bound
theorems.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} {C : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype R] [inst_1 : Fintype C] [inst_2 : Nonempty C] (M : R → C → Bool)
  (η : Real),
  Real.instLE.le 0 η →
    ∀ (hη1 : Real.instLT.lt η 1) (v : Real)
      (hrow :
        ∀ (q : ProbabilityTheory.FintypePMF C),
          Exists fun r =>
            Real.instLE.le v (Finset.univ.sum fun c => instHMul.hMul (q.prob c) (ite (Eq (M r c) Bool.true) 1 0)))
      (T : Nat),
      Real.instLE.le (ProbabilityTheory.mwuConfig M η hη1 v hrow T).potential
        (instHMul.hMul (Fintype.card C).cast (instHPow.hPow (instHSub.hSub 1 (instHMul.hMul η v)) T))

theorems.name: ProbabilityTheory.mwu_approx_minimax
theorems.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} {C : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype R] [inst_1 : Fintype C] [Nonempty R] [Nonempty C] [DecidableEq R]
  [DecidableEq C] (M : R → C → Bool) (v ε : Real),
  Real.instLT.lt 0 ε →
    (∀ (q : ProbabilityTheory.FintypePMF C),
        Exists fun r =>
          Real.instLE.le v (Finset.univ.sum fun c => instHMul.hMul (q.prob c) (ite (Eq (M r c) Bool.true) 1 0))) →
      Exists fun p => ∀ (c : C), Real.instLE.le (instHSub.hSub v ε) (ProbabilityTheory.boolGamePayoff M p c)
